configuration.title: LLMemory command
configuration.description: Where the llmemory program is, as a full path. Empty: the llmemory on your login shell's PATH.

configuration.title: Brain folder
configuration.description: The brain's folder, the one llmemory reads with --home. Brain lists nothing until it is set.

configuration.title: Wrap code in notes
configuration.description: Long lines in a note's code blocks wrap instead of scrolling sideways. The wrap button on a block switches it too.

show.description: Shows Bot on Services, Workflows, Schedules or Brain, a Forge view on the session given.

session.title: Forge session
session.description: The session the Forge views show. Absent: the one chosen.

choose-session.description: Chooses which daemon the Forge views show.

search-brain.description: Lists the notes of the brain that match a search, in Brain.

read-note.description: Opens a note of the brain in Brain.
